name: Career Forge — AI Resume & Job Match Studio
tagline: Instant ATS scoring, XYZ bullet rewrites, cover letters & interview prep.
description:
Stop guessing why your resume gets rejected — and start fixing exactly what's costing you the interview.

Career Forge turns Anna into your personal AI Career & ATS Optimization Studio. Paste any resume and job description — or tap a 1-click role preset — and get an instant, fully transparent compatibility breakdown.

**ATS Match & Keyword Radar** — Not one opaque number. Career Forge scores you across four separate dimensions: Technical Match, Keyword Alignment, Quantified Impact, and ATS Readiness — so you know precisely which dimension is dragging you down. Then it shows the exact keywords from the job description you're missing.

**XYZ Bullet Optimizer** — One click turns vague duty statements into measurable achievements, seeded with the keywords you were missing. "Worked on microservices" becomes "Architected 6 Python microservices handling 85,000+ daily requests at 99.95% uptime."

**Tailored Cover Letter Generator** — Role-specific cover letters in three tones (modern, technical, executive), grounded in your strongest matched skills. Never generic filler.

**Targeted STAR Interview Prep** — Technical and behavioural questions aimed squarely at your identified skill gaps, so you rehearse the questions you're most likely to be asked.

**Persistent Scan History** — Every scan is saved automatically. Track your score as you iterate and watch it climb.

**Private by design** — Scoring runs entirely on your device through a bundled Python engine. Your resume is never uploaded anywhere, and the engine declares no host capabilities. No API keys, no account, no LLM cost.

**How to use** — Open Career Forge from your Anna App Deck, or mention #career-forge in any chat. Pick a role preset or paste your resume and target job description, then click Run ATS Match Scan. Ask Anna Coach for follow-up guidance at any time.
